description: Screen a payment ENDPOINT (URL or domain) before calling it — the half that address screening cannot answer. In x402 the agent discovers a URL first, receives a 402, and only then learns where to pay: if that endpoint is spoofed, the payee address it hands back is freshly generated and appears on no sanctions list. Checks the hostname and its parent domains against public phishing-domain lists plus hostname shape signals. Returns clear | caution | risky | unknown with language-independent signal_keys. clear means no match was found, NOT that the endpoint is safe. Use together with screen_address. Free, no API key.

url.description: Full URL or bare domain of the payment endpoint, e.g. https://pay.example.com/x402 or pay.example.com

name: screen_endpoint
title: Screen a payment endpoint for phishing (free)
